subject: Interview cadence & panel rotation — Inference backfill (Req INF-238)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: [Req INF-238] Proposal: interview cadence and panel rotation for backfill

Hi all,

We need to open a backfill for Alan's role (he's moving teams next month). I put together a lean plan so we can move quickly without compromising signal. High level: open Req INF-238 (Inference Platform Engineer - backfill), create a 3-stage interview slate, and rotate two interview panels so we don't overbook the same folks every week.

Proposed interview slate:
- Stage 1: 30m recruiter screen (Hannah will run)
- Stage 2: 90m deep system design + code read (panel: 2 infra engineers + 1 product PM)
- Stage 3: 60m on-call simulation + runbook troubleshooting (SRE + inference infra)

Panel rotation idea (week A / week B):
- Week A: Marcus/Marissa as leads for Stage 2; Mina + Evelyn on Stage 3
- Week B: Aditya + Diego for Stage 2; Mina + another SRE for Stage 3

Tentative calendar slots for panels are in the Greenhouse prep link: https://greenhouse.io/reqs/INF-238 and I added a provisional calendar block here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=panelslots-INF-238

Attachments: INF-238-job-desc-v1.docx (draft JD)

Asks:
1) Can Marissa / Mina confirm this slate and panel rotation?
2) Evelyn/Aditya — do you have capacity from the budget/policy side to open the req this week?
3) If approved, I'd like Hannah to start running screens for the top two candidates we've pre-screened by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
